text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle takes me to a mall to shop
for skin
care products on our day off...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't look like they have it here
either. But
nothin' else'll do...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... If I don't get my hands on some,
my skin's
gonna be as dry as the desert
at high noon...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, truth is I've never seen it in Japan
before.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Guess there's nothing to do but wait for my family to send me some.
